sine_yoke.name: Hand wheel / visible sine yoke
sine_yoke.description: Turn the exposed crank by hand. The pin slides horizontally inside the yoke, whose height carries a timber cube on vertical guides. Stop or reverse at any position.
sine_yoke.qfep_connection: Makes the ideal constraint visible: a circle becomes a line by allowing one direction and constraining the other. Kinematic linkage, not force-based mechanics.
interactions: Desktop: drag around the wheel rim or crank.
XR: grip the wooden crank and move the hand around the wheel.

parameters.initial_angle: Initial wheel position in degrees. No automatic drive.
